sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Americans have always had an uneasy relationship with gambling.
sentences.zh: 美国人与赌博的关系一直很微妙。

sentences.en: To circumvent anti-gambling laws in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 为了规避美国的反赌博法，

sentences.en: early slot machines masqueraded as vending machines.
sentences.zh: 早期的老虎机伪装成了自动售货机。

sentences.en: Or a trade machine, as they were called.
sentences.zh: 或者像当时人们所称的“贸易机”。

sentences.en: And the symbols on the machine had to obscure its true intent.
sentences.zh: 机器上的符号必须掩盖其真实意图。

sentences.en: So you'd have these fruit symbols of cherries and lemons and oranges on the reels,
sentences.zh: 所以转轮上会有樱桃、柠檬和橙子这类水果符号，

sentences.en: and they would offer prizes.
sentences.zh: 它们会提供奖品。

sentences.en: Like chewing gum or other treats.
sentences.zh: 比如口香糖或其他零食。

sentences.en: That you would then have to redeem for cash.
sentences.zh: 然后你得把这些奖品兑换成现金。

sentences.en: Like tickets at Chuck E.
sentences.zh: 就像查克芝士店里的奖券一样。

sentences.en: Cheese.
sentences.zh: （查克芝士店）

sentences.en: So it was almost like laundering it back into money.
sentences.zh: 所以这几乎就像是把奖品洗回现金。

sentences.en: Many slot machines have retained the fruit symbols to this day.
sentences.zh: 许多老虎机至今仍保留着水果符号。

sentences.en: Heck, in the U.K., they're actually called fruit machines because of this.
sentences.zh: 见鬼，在英国，它们甚至因此被称为“水果机”。

sentences.en: So that is a carryover from that era.
sentences.zh: 所以这是从那个时代沿袭下来的。

sentences.en: The near-universal bar symbol, which I always thought represented stacks of bars of gold,
sentences.zh: 那种几乎随处可见的“BAR”符号，我一直以为它代表着一叠叠金条，

sentences.en: has a similar origin.
sentences.zh: 其实也有类似的起源。

sentences.en: The bar symbol is actually based on the logo of the Bell Fruit Gum Company.
sentences.zh: “BAR”符号实际上源自贝尔水果口香糖公司的标志。

sentences.en: I'm talking with Natasha Dow Shell.
sentences.zh: 我正在与娜塔莎·道·舒尔交谈。

sentences.en: My name is Natasha Dow Shell, and I'm an associate professor at MIT.
sentences.zh: 我叫娜塔莎·道·舒尔，是麻省理工学院的副教授。

sentences.en: And the title of my book is Addiction by Design.
sentences.zh: 我的书名是《设计成瘾》。

sentences.en: All about machine gambling in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 全书讲述的是拉斯维加斯的机器赌博。

sentences.en: You can probably picture a slot machine pretty easily.
sentences.zh: 你可能很容易就能想象出老虎机的样子。

sentences.en: The image we have that we carry around in our minds of the slot machine.
sentences.zh: 我们脑海中一直留存着老虎机的形象。

sentences.en: It's pretty much the same machine that came out in 1895.
sentences.zh: 它和1895年问世的机器几乎一模一样。

sentences.en: Three reels, mechanical reels, that spin, and you are playing to line up symbols across one line.
sentences.zh: 三个机械转轮在旋转，你玩游戏是为了让符号在一条线上对齐。

sentences.en: So one bar of symbols.
sentences.zh: 也就是一行符号。

sentences.en: And to get the machine to play, you're putting in coins, and then you're reaching up with your arm and pulling this lever.
sentences.zh: 要让机器运转，你得投入硬币，然后伸手拉动那个操纵杆。

sentences.en: So it's a very mechanical interaction.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种非常机械的互动。

sentences.en: This is the famous one-armed bandit.
sentences.zh: 这就是著名的“单臂强盗”。

sentences.en: Today, if you walk into a casino, you may still see those levers, but they have a new name, legacy levers.
sentences.zh: 今天，如果你走进赌场，可能还会看到那些操纵杆，但它们有了个新名字：遗产操纵杆。

sentences.en: Because they're basically just there to evoke that bygone mechanical machine and to attract us over.
sentences.zh: 因为它们的存在基本上只是为了唤起人们对过去机械机器的回忆，并吸引我们过去。

sentences.en: We recognize it.
sentences.zh: 我们认得它。

sentences.en: We can pull the lever.
sentences.zh: 我们可以拉动操纵杆。

sentences.en: But we very quickly realize after sitting down that it's a lot faster and more efficient and ultimately less fatiguing if we're sitting there for a while to press the buttons or,
sentences.zh: 但坐下后我们很快就会意识到，如果我们要在那里坐上一会儿，按按钮或者——

sentences.en: in some cases, to touch the screen.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，触摸屏幕——会更快、更高效，而且最终没那么累。

sentences.en: A classic skeuomorph.
sentences.zh: 一个典型的拟物设计。

sentences.en: The physical machine, the hardware that you're interacting with, has really shifted.
sentences.zh: 物理机器，也就是你与之互动的硬件，确实已经发生了改变。

sentences.en: Skeuomorphs are design elements that are retained as an ornament past the point where they serve any meaningful function.
sentences.zh: 拟物设计是指那些在失去实际功能后，仍作为装饰被保留下来的设计元素。

sentences.en: And slot machines are skeuomorphic champions.
sentences.zh: 而老虎机正是拟物设计的佼佼者。

sentences.en: They're lousy with design elements that make you feel like you're interacting with a trustworthy mechanical object.
sentences.zh: 它们充斥着各种设计元素，让你感觉自己是在与一个值得信赖的机械物体互动。

sentences.en: And it's not just the legacy levers.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是那些“遗产操纵杆”。

sentences.en: It's also the screen you're looking at.
sentences.zh: 还有你盯着看的屏幕。

sentences.en: So this is typically now a video screen rather than a mechanical three-reel setup.
sentences.zh: 现在这通常是一个视频屏幕，而不是机械的三转轮装置。

sentences.en: Some of these video machines, however, try to make us think we're playing a mechanical machine.
sentences.zh: 然而，有些视频机器试图让我们以为自己在玩机械机器。

sentences.en: They sort of have a kind of analog ka-ching, ka-ching to them.
sentences.zh: 它们自带一种模拟的“咔哒、咔哒”声。

sentences.en: Military visual mapping technology is used.
sentences.zh: 它们使用了军事视觉映射技术。

sentences.en: It's like this three-layer plasma screen.
sentences.zh: 就像这种三层等离子屏幕。

sentences.en: So there are actual reels spinning.
sentences.zh: 所以确实有转轮在旋转。

sentences.en: They're blank.
sentences.zh: 它们是空白的。

sentences.en: And what's happening is there's a video projection onto them.
sentences.zh: 发生的情况是，上面投射了视频影像。

sentences.en: So it's not like they're marked with actual symbols.
sentences.zh: 所以它们并不是真的印着符号。

sentences.en: The symbols that appear can just be changed up.
sentences.zh: 出现的符号可以随时更换。

sentences.en: There's lots of little tricks by which designers try to get us to feel that we are still playing an analog mechanical device.
sentences.zh: 设计师用了许多小花招，试图让我们觉得我们仍在玩一种模拟机械设备。

sentences.en: According to CBS News, Americans now spend more money on slot machines than movies, baseball, and theme parks combined.
sentences.zh: 据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，美国人现在在老虎机上花的钱比电影、棒球和主题公园加起来还要多。

sentences.en: But this wasn't always the case.
sentences.zh: 但情况并非一直如此。

sentences.en: These were seen as really just frivolous little devices that were there to occupy the wives of the real gamblers or to occupy people in these sort of transitional spaces while they were waiting in line or in hallways or around the fringes of the main gambling pit.
sentences.zh: 这些机器曾被视为纯粹的消遣小玩意，用来打发真正赌徒的妻子们，或者让人们在排队、走廊或主赌区边缘等过渡空间里消磨时间。

sentences.en: So they didn't tend to have stools, much less the precise ergonomic seating that they have today.
sentences.zh: 所以它们通常没有凳子，更不用说今天这种精确的人体工程学座椅了。

sentences.en: They weren't destinations.
sentences.zh: 它们不是目的地。

sentences.en: They were really transitional devices.
sentences.zh: 它们确实只是过渡性的设备。

sentences.en: But not anymore.
sentences.zh: 但现在不同了。

sentences.en: And then there is this historical association in this country between women, particularly older women nowadays, and these slot machines.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个国家，女性，尤其是如今的老年女性，与这些老虎机之间存在着一种历史性的关联。

sentences.en: So in every way, these machines are thought of as being light, a light form of gambling.
sentences.zh: 所以从各方面来看，这些机器都被认为是一种轻松的赌博形式。

sentences.en: And the real irony there is that these machines that anyone can – very approachable.
sentences.zh: 而真正的讽刺在于，这些任何人都能玩——非常容易上手的机器，

sentences.en: You don't have to know the rules.
sentences.zh: 你不需要懂规则。

sentences.en: You don't have to be wearing a suit or interact with other people in some intimidating way.
sentences.zh: 你不需要穿西装，也不需要以某种令人生畏的方式与他人互动。

sentences.en: The irony is that they are the most potent, if you want to use that word, in terms of how addicting they are.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，如果非要用这个词的话，它们在成瘾性方面是最强大的。

sentences.en: It's been shown that you get problematically involved with these devices three to four times faster than you would at the racetrack or playing card games.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，你沉迷于这些设备的速度，比在赛马场或玩纸牌游戏快三到四倍。

sentences.en: Problematically involved is my new favorite euphemism.
sentences.zh: “沉迷于”是我最喜欢的新委婉语。

sentences.en: Despite the slot machine's very familiar appearance, this is a device that has evolved dramatically with one goal in mind – to keep you playing that machine.
sentences.zh: 尽管老虎机的外观非常熟悉，但这种设备已经发生了巨大的演变，其目标只有一个——让你一直玩下去。

sentences.en: We often think, especially people who don't play these machines, the assumption is people must be playing these machines, especially the people who play them a lot,
sentences.zh: 我们经常认为，尤其是那些不玩这些机器的人，会假设人们玩这些机器，特别是那些经常玩的人，

sentences.en: because they want to win.
sentences.zh: 是因为他们想赢。

sentences.en: And these are sort of dupes.
sentences.zh: 他们被视为某种傻瓜。

sentences.en: These are poor people who don't understand how probability works.
sentences.zh: 他们是那些不懂概率原理的穷人。

sentences.en: They're not rational.
sentences.zh: 他们是不理性的。

sentences.en: If only they could be educated, they'd make these proper consumer decisions.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能接受教育，就能做出正确的消费决策。

sentences.en: But in fact, if you talk to a lot of these gamblers, they are incredibly savvy.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，如果你和许多这样的赌徒交谈，会发现他们非常精明。

sentences.en: They're not dupes.
sentences.zh: 他们不是傻瓜。

sentences.en: They know they're not going to win.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己不会赢。

sentences.en: And they know that if they do win a jackpot, that means they'll just sit there longer and play it off.
sentences.zh: 而且他们知道，如果真的中了头奖，那意味着他们只会坐在那里更久，把钱输光。

sentences.en: So it's not really about winning.
sentences.zh: 所以这根本不是为了赢。

sentences.en: It's about getting into the zone.
sentences.zh: 而是为了进入那种“心流”状态。

sentences.en: Everything else falls away.
sentences.zh: 其他一切都消失了。

sentences.en: A sense of monetary value, time, space, even a sense of self is annihilated in the extreme form of this zone that you enter.
sentences.zh: 金钱价值感、时间、空间，甚至自我意识，在这种极端的心流状态下都会被湮灭。

sentences.en: There was one moment in Shul's research where the whole concept of the zone really sunk in for her.
sentences.zh: 在舒尔的研究中，有一个时刻让她真正深刻理解了“心流”这个概念。

sentences.en: She was talking with a gambler.
sentences.zh: 她当时正在和一位赌徒交谈。

sentences.en: And she said, you know, sometimes I have to say I get this sense of frustration and irritation when I win a jackpot, because it just freezes up my flow.
sentences.zh: 那人说，你知道，有时我不得不说，当我中了头奖时，我会感到一种挫败和烦躁，因为它打断了我的节奏。

sentences.en: I just want to continue playing.
sentences.zh: 我只想继续玩下去。

sentences.en: I've witnessed this in a casino.
sentences.zh: 我在赌场里亲眼见过这种情况。

sentences.en: The player wins, and as the credits are accruing, ding, ding, ding, ding, ding, they're just continuing to bang that spin button.
sentences.zh: 玩家赢了，当积分不断累积时，叮、叮、叮、叮、叮，他们只是继续疯狂地按着旋转按钮。

sentences.en: They just can't wait to hit it again.
sentences.zh: 他们迫不及待地想再来一次。

sentences.en: So there's this design imperative to overcome the problem of interruption, a design imperative to overcome the player's problem with winning.
sentences.zh: 所以，设计上有一种迫切的需求来克服中断问题，一种克服玩家因赢钱而产生困扰的迫切需求。

sentences.en: And, you know, the gambling industry has its own way of phrasing this.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，博彩业有他们自己的一套说法。

sentences.en: They're aware of this zone.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到这种心流状态的存在。

sentences.en: Sometimes they call it a zone.
sentences.zh: 有时他们称之为“心流”。

sentences.en: They also have a term that there are play-to-win players or jackpot players.
sentences.zh: 他们还有一个术语，即“以赢为目的的玩家”或“头奖玩家”。

sentences.en: And then there's play-to-win-to-play players.
sentences.zh: 还有“为了玩而赢的玩家”。

sentences.en: Otherwise known as time-on-device players.
sentences.zh: 也就是所谓的“设备时长玩家”。

sentences.en: And Shul's book tracks this sea change in the gambling industry away from jackpot play and towards time-on-device play.
sentences.zh: 舒尔的书追踪了博彩业从头奖游戏向设备时长游戏的巨大转变。

sentences.en: So this is not play where you go in and you're excited and you're out to get this euphoric thrill from a big win.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是那种让你兴奋不已，为了追求大奖带来的快感而玩的游戏。

sentences.en: Or from the industry side, you're not out to sort of fleece someone and take all their money right away and then get them off the machine so you can take someone else's money.
sentences.zh: 或者从行业角度看，你不是为了榨干某人，立刻拿走他们所有的钱，然后让他们离开机器，好去赚下一个人的钱。

sentences.en: This is more about profit from volume.
sentences.zh: 这更多是关于通过规模获利。

sentences.en: The idea is that gamblers want to sit there longer and the industry has realized profit really isn't about the price of play.
sentences.zh: 其理念是赌徒们想坐得更久，而博彩业已经意识到利润其实不在于单次游戏的成本。

sentences.en: It's about the volume of play.
sentences.zh: 而在于游戏的频率。

sentences.en: And once you understand that, it begins to make a lot more sense why penny machines, machines played with a denomination of one cent,
sentences.zh: 一旦你理解了这一点，为什么一分钱机器——即面值为一分的机器——

sentences.en: are generating higher profits than any other machine today.
sentences.zh: 比当今任何其他机器产生更高利润，就变得容易理解多了。

sentences.en: Now, if you had asked the industry a decade ago what's going to become of penny machines, they would have laughed at you.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你十年前问博彩业一分钱机器会有什么前途，他们会嘲笑你。

sentences.en: Because at that stage, even nickel machines were considered – they were really mocked as games you'd only find in grind joints.
sentences.zh: 因为在那个阶段，连五分钱机器都被视为——它们真的被嘲笑为只能在廉价赌场里找到的游戏。

sentences.en: But if we look closely at some technological advances that certain makers have hit upon, they started to realize, aha,
sentences.zh: 但如果我们仔细观察某些制造商发现的技术进步，他们开始意识到，啊哈，

sentences.en: if we take the bet and we break it down into pennies and find ways with the computer algorithms inside the machine to extend betting over a longer period,
sentences.zh: 如果我们把赌注拆分成一分钱，并利用机器内部的计算机算法找到延长投注时间的方法，

sentences.en: we can ultimately make more money.
sentences.zh: 我们最终能赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: So the lights and the sound attract you.
sentences.zh: 所以灯光和声音吸引你。

sentences.en: The casino atmospherics draw you in.
sentences.zh: 赌场的氛围吸引你。

sentences.en: The ergonomic seats keep you comfortable.
sentences.zh: 人体工程学座椅让你感到舒适。

sentences.en: The max bet and spin buttons don't even require you to move your hand from its resting position.
sentences.zh: 最大投注和旋转按钮甚至不需要你移动手的位置。

sentences.en: The recess screen pulls you into your own private world.
sentences.zh: 凹陷的屏幕将你拉入自己的私人世界。

sentences.en: And you enter the zone.
sentences.zh: 然后你进入了心流状态。

sentences.en: But what's going to keep you playing is the math.
sentences.zh: 但真正让你一直玩下去的是数学逻辑。

sentences.en: And that's really the revolution of these new video slots.
sentences.zh: 这确实是这些新型视频老虎机的革命所在。

sentences.en: And the math, and that's the term the industry uses, has gotten very complicated.
sentences.zh: 而“数学逻辑”——这是业内使用的术语——已经变得非常复杂。

sentences.en: So if you imagine our friend the old one-armed bandit, you had these three reels with symbols on them.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想象我们那位老朋友“单臂强盗”，你有三个带有符号的转轮。

sentences.en: And you were betting on lining up one single line of symbols across.
sentences.zh: 你押注的是让一行符号对齐。

sentences.en: Now, even on mechanical machines, designers quickly found creative ways to add in other lines of play.
sentences.zh: 现在，即使在机械机器上，设计师也很快找到了增加其他游戏线的创造性方法。

sentences.en: So usually when you see these reels, you can sort of see the line above and the line below.
sentences.zh: 所以通常当你看到这些转轮时，你多少能看到上面一行和下面一行。

sentences.en: The genius of showing extra lines above and below the winning line is that it introduces the near-miss phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 在获胜线上下方显示额外线条的天才之处在于，它引入了“险些获胜”的现象。

sentences.en: It's that feeling that you almost won when you see that winning symbol so close on that adjacent line.
sentences.zh: 当你看到获胜符号在相邻线上如此接近时，会产生一种你差点就赢了的感觉。

sentences.en: But the extra lines are also available for placing extra bets.
sentences.zh: 但这些额外的线条也可以用来进行额外的投注。

sentences.en: So the idea was, let's let people bet on three lines and let them bet instead of, you know, one token,
sentences.zh: 所以想法是，让人们在三条线上投注，让他们不是只投一个筹码，

sentences.en: they can bet two tokens on two lines or three.
sentences.zh: 而是可以在两条或三条线上投两个筹码。

sentences.en: So you did see these early multi-coin games, but there was limits to them because there's really a limit when you're talking about mechanical reels
sentences.zh: 所以你确实看到了这些早期的多币游戏，但它们有局限性，因为当你谈论机械转轮时，

sentences.en: to how many symbols you can fit on the screen.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上能容纳的符号数量确实有限。

sentences.en: But then video technology came along and slot machines could do whatever the designer wanted.
sentences.zh: 但后来视频技术出现了，老虎机可以随心所欲地设计。

sentences.en: So you started seeing this progression from not just lines, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以你开始看到这种演变，不仅仅是线条，你知道，

sentences.en: you had even your two diagonals from the corners of the screen down.
sentences.zh: 你甚至有了从屏幕角落向下延伸的两条对角线。

sentences.en: Then you started seeing, well, let's add extra reels.
sentences.zh: 然后你开始看到，好吧，我们增加额外的转轮吧。

sentences.en: Let's add five, six, seven reels across.
sentences.zh: 我们增加五、六、七个转轮。

sentences.en: And let's add zigzags and, you know, weird directions.
sentences.zh: 我们增加锯齿形和各种奇怪的方向。

sentences.en: So it's typical today to see 20, 50, 100 line games.
sentences.zh: 所以今天看到20线、50线、100线的游戏是很常见的。

sentences.en: And it gets so complicated, it begins to get really hard to tell if you even won or not.
sentences.zh: 而且它变得如此复杂，以至于你甚至很难分辨自己到底赢没赢。

sentences.en: The on-screen graphics have to draw the lines for you.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上的图形必须为你画出线条。

sentences.en: Some machines have even gone so far as to do away with lining up all together.
sentences.zh: 有些机器甚至走得更远，完全取消了对齐要求。

sentences.en: They have what's called scatter play.
sentences.zh: 它们有所谓的“分散支付”。

sentences.en: So it's really quite random.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实相当随机。

sentences.en: You're no longer playing to line up that one line of symbols across.
sentences.zh: 你不再是为了对齐那一行符号而玩。

sentences.en: Which is insane.
sentences.zh: 这简直疯了。

sentences.en: So that's all going on.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都在发生。

sentences.en: And you say, well, what's going on here?
sentences.zh: 你会说，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: What's significant about that is that if you're playing on a penny machine,
sentences.zh: 其意义在于，如果你在玩一分钱机器，

sentences.en: you decide that you're going to bet a penny per line.
sentences.zh: 你决定每条线押注一分钱。

sentences.en: So that would be 100 pennies.
sentences.zh: 所以总共就是100分钱。

sentences.en: That's a dollar.
sentences.zh: 也就是一美元。

sentences.en: In fact, you can max it out and bet, you know, three pennies per line.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你可以把注码拉满，比如每条线押注三分钱。

sentences.en: So in fact, you're making $3 a bet.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，你实际上每把要押注3美元。

sentences.en: That's quite significant.
sentences.zh: 这数额相当可观。

sentences.en: You know, when quarter players started disappearing, when video slots came out,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当视频老虎机出现，25美分硬币的老虎机玩家开始减少时，

sentences.en: researchers were sent onto casino floors to find out where are our quarter players going?
sentences.zh: 研究人员被派往赌场大厅，想找出我们的25美分玩家都去哪了？

sentences.en: Are they migrating to dollars as we thought they would?
sentences.zh: 他们是否像我们预想的那样转向了美元老虎机？

sentences.en: No, they were kind of regressing back to nickel machines.
sentences.zh: 并没有，他们反而退回到了分币机上。

sentences.en: But in the end, they were actually paying more.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他们实际上付出的更多。

sentences.en: They were betting more per hand than they had on the quarter machines.
sentences.zh: 他们每手押注的金额比在25美分机器上还要多。

sentences.en: So the question is, why would a gambler do that?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，赌徒为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: The slots aren't more appealing because they take more coins.
sentences.zh: 老虎机并不会因为吃掉更多硬币就变得更有吸引力。

sentences.en: Here's the real trick.
sentences.zh: 真正的诀窍在这里。

sentences.en: When you're betting 300 pennies on 100 lines, you're going to win back a portion of those.
sentences.zh: 当你把300分钱押在100条线上时，你会赢回其中的一部分。

sentences.en: For the first time in history, you're not betting a token and then losing it all or doubling it, tripling it.
sentences.zh: 这是历史上第一次，你不再是押下一个筹码，然后要么全输，要么翻倍或翻三倍。

sentences.en: That's a really volatile setup.
sentences.zh: 那是一种波动性极大的玩法。

sentences.en: This is much less volatile.
sentences.zh: 而这种方式的波动性要小得多。

sentences.en: You're spreading your bet across 100 lines.
sentences.zh: 你把注码分散到了100条线上。

sentences.en: And it's really a lot safer if you want to see it that way, because chances are you're going to win back something on some of those lines.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意这么看的话，这确实安全得多，因为你很有可能在其中的某些线上赢回一些钱。

sentences.en: And it just so happens that these machines are designed, when you win back something, to give you all the winning stimuli that comes along with a real win.
sentences.zh: 而且这些机器的设计恰好是，当你赢回一点钱时，会给你带来与真正赢钱时完全一样的获胜刺激感。

sentences.en: And so one researcher has aptly called this a false win or losses disguised as wins, because, you know, you're putting in 45 coins, you're winning, quote unquote,
sentences.zh: 所以一位研究人员恰如其分地称之为“虚假胜利”或“伪装成胜利的失败”，因为你知道，你投入了45个硬币，却赢回了——所谓的——

sentences.en: winning nine back.
sentences.zh: 赢回了9个。

sentences.en: That's a pretty radical net loss.
sentences.zh: 这其实是相当严重的净亏损。

sentences.en: But yet there's little ditties that are being played.
sentences.zh: 但机器依然会播放那些欢快的小曲。

sentences.en: It's virtually no different than when you really do win.
sentences.zh: 这和你真正赢钱时几乎没什么两样。

sentences.en: Another key factor in making penny machines possible in all their little micro bets.
sentences.zh: 让分币机及其所有微小注码成为可能的另一个关键因素，

sentences.en: Are updates on how the player feeds money into the machine.
sentences.zh: 是玩家向机器投币方式的更新。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is a huge part of it.
sentences.zh: 没错，这是其中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Alongside the ergonomics of the chairs and the changes in the responsivity of the buttons and how they're placed came the financial access technology.
sentences.zh: 除了椅子的舒适度、按钮响应速度和布局的改变之外，金融接入技术也随之而来。

sentences.en: And, you know, if you think about the past, if you ran out of money and you wanted to continue to play at a machine, there was a lot of steps you had to.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你回想过去，如果你没钱了还想继续玩，那得经过很多步骤。

sentences.en: You really had to work for it.
sentences.zh: 你真的得费一番功夫。

sentences.en: You had to leave your machine, maybe wouldn't be there when you got back, ask someone to hold it, then go off in search of an ATM, get some cash.
sentences.zh: 你得离开你的机器——等你回来时它可能已经被别人占了——还得找人帮你看着，然后去寻找自动取款机取现金。

sentences.en: Then you had to search out a cashier's cage or a roving chain attendant, buy these coins, return to a machine, open the coins and put them in one by one.
sentences.zh: 接着你得去找收银台或巡场的服务员，买这些硬币，回到机器旁，拆开硬币袋，一个一个投进去。

sentences.en: That was very labor intensive.
sentences.zh: 那真是非常耗费体力。

sentences.en: And then imagine feeding in 300 pennies.
sentences.zh: 再想象一下投入300个分币的情景。

sentences.en: So you started seeing bill acceptors.
sentences.zh: 所以后来出现了纸币接收器。

sentences.en: It would take $20.
sentences.zh: 它能吃进20美元。

sentences.en: It was sort of a move to credit play.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种向信用额度游戏的转变。

sentences.en: And with the bill acceptors, you got these little digital monitors where it wasn't exactly telling you how much money was in the machine.
sentences.zh: 有了纸币接收器，你就有了这些小小的数字显示屏，它显示的并不完全是你机器里有多少钱。

sentences.en: It was telling you how many credits.
sentences.zh: 它显示的是你有多少点数。

sentences.en: So already there with bill acceptors, you saw a kind of turn toward credit play, which really dematerialized the money, made it less real somehow,
sentences.zh: 所以有了纸币接收器，你已经看到了向信用额度游戏的一种转变，这确实让金钱变得“非物质化”了，在某种程度上让它显得不那么真实，

sentences.en: and allowed you to get in that zone, you know, disconnected you again from the everyday world.
sentences.zh: 并让你进入那种状态，你知道，再次让你与现实世界脱节。

sentences.en: Nowadays, a lot of machine gambling uses these player reward cards.
sentences.zh: 如今，许多机器赌博都使用这种玩家奖励卡。

sentences.en: Which are essentially credit cards that the casino sets up for you where you store credit.
sentences.zh: 这本质上就是赌场为你开设的信用卡，用来存储点数。

sentences.en: You'll often go into a casino and see people.
sentences.zh: 你经常走进赌场看到人们，

sentences.en: They're seemingly connected to these machines,
sentences.zh: 他们似乎与这些机器连接在一起，

sentences.en: almost like life support with these plastic bungee cords that are attached to their cards so they won't forget them and lose them there.
sentences.zh: 就像靠生命维持系统一样，用塑料弹力绳连着他们的卡，这样他们就不会忘记或弄丢。

sentences.en: So you'll look down a whole line and everyone's sort of attached to these machines with these plastic ropes.
sentences.zh: 所以你顺着一排机器看过去，每个人都用这种塑料绳连在机器上。

sentences.en: But ticket in,
sentences.zh: 但是“票据进、

sentences.en: ticket out technology where you're playing with these barcoded tickets and player cards were really necessary piece of the technological puzzle for pennies to come on the scene in the way that they did with multi-line machines.
sentences.zh: 票据出”技术，也就是你用这些带条形码的票据和玩家卡进行游戏，确实是多线老虎机能以这种方式出现在舞台上的必要技术拼图。

sentences.en: And this design evolution is the reason why slot machines are the most profitable form of gambling,
sentences.zh: 这种设计演变正是老虎机成为最赚钱赌博形式的原因，

sentences.en: even though there is no skill involved and the player doesn't even know the odds of winning for any given machine.
sentences.zh: 尽管这其中不涉及任何技巧，而且玩家甚至不知道任何一台机器的胜率。

sentences.en: One gambler in my book, Rose, who said, you know, I became a slot machine technician to understand more about these machines.
sentences.zh: 我书中的一位赌徒罗斯说，你知道，我成为了一名老虎机技术员，想更多地了解这些机器。

sentences.en: And I thought it would be a good part of my recovery from the addiction because I thought if I understand how these machines work, the spell will be broken.
sentences.zh: 我以为这对我的戒瘾康复会有帮助，因为我想如果我了解了这些机器的工作原理，魔咒就会被打破。

sentences.en: And she said, you know, even after I was putting these machines together and designing them at work, on my lunch breaks,
sentences.zh: 但她说，你知道，即使在工作中我亲自组装和设计这些机器，在午休时间，

sentences.en: I would just go down the street and play the exact same machines.
sentences.zh: 我还是会跑到街上去玩完全一样的机器。

sentences.en: Because that is how addiction works.
sentences.zh: 因为这就是成瘾的运作方式。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is Sam Green's fan and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》由萨姆·格林（Sam Green）和我，罗曼·马尔斯（Roman Mars）制作。

sentences.en: We're a project of 91.7 local public radio KALW in San Francisco and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7本地公共广播电台KALW和旧金山美国建筑师协会的一个项目。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并关注我们的节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars, but we'll have more info about Shul's really great book, Addiction by Design, and her film about all-you-can-eat Vegas buffets.
sentences.zh: 我会在推特上发布信息，账号是Roman Mars，但我们会有更多关于舒尔（Shul）那本非常棒的书《成瘾设计》（Addiction by Design）以及她关于拉斯维加斯自助餐纪录片的信息。

sentences.en: Oh my god.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: At our website, 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 请访问我们的网站 99percentinvisible.org。

sentences.en: Videotopia.
sentences.zh: Videotopia。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
